name: linux-desktop-configuration
description: Shared Linux desktop (GNOME/Ubuntu) configuration rules for Codex agents: safe GNOME Shell reloads, clean-install compatibility, and root-optional installers.

interface.shortDescription: GNOME Shell reload safety, clean-install rules, and sudo-free installer patterns.
interface.longDescription: Keeps the shared Linux desktop configuration guidance available as a reusable Codex skill: in-place GNOME Shell reloads (X11 Alt+F2 r), Wayland restrictions, forbidden session-terminating commands, clean installation compatibility, and the root-optional installer pattern that avoids sudo wherever possible.
defaultPrompt: Apply the Linux desktop configuration guidelines to this task.
